editorial: Imagine your favorite bikini-clad duo turning detective on a quirky whodunit—this premise hooks you right away. What sets it apart is the fearless mix of body‑positive humor and razor‑sharp mystery, all driven by Janno Gibbs’ sardonic stand‑up flair. A standout moment occurs when Astrid and Audrey use a portable pump to lift evidence, turning a clever pun into a physical gag that keeps the pace lively. You’ll find yourself laughing until your cheeks ache, proving comedy and crime can coexist. The only hiccup is a mid‑act slump that pulls the momentum toward a predictable pacing lull.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of upbeat rom-coms with sharp wit and lovable side characters.
